scenario: Two modules arrive without provenance: an organization-managed one is rejected outright; a project one requires explicit recorded content review before it may run.
when: both modules are presented for loading

reasons: 'org-release-gate' rejected — organization-managed modules require provenance and change control
'team-lint-hook' blocked pending explicit recorded trust review of its content
must_not: accept user or project consent as a substitute for organization provenance
run the project module while its review is pending
convert the pending review into a silent allow after a timeout
